phase: Bounded current-policy preflight of the three remaining legacy type-only A/B records
scopeBoundary: Only the three named remaining records were researched. No other venue source, seat draft, production data, generated artifact, or runtime behavior was changed.
policyBasis: Fixed seats, outdoor use, movable seating, and multiple layouts are not standalone blockers. ADOPT requires a current/current-linked issuer-numbered map or seat list, a reasonable representative configuration, a lossless complete printed set, and issuer evidence for ownership. Where no issuer-numbered set exists, IDs or ownership must not be inferred from geometry or capacity.
